message.content:
The card starts with the diagram facing us. The first move is a flip to the left, which turns the card over to its back side (the plain white side). The second move is a flip upwards. This action flips the card from the bottom edge to the top edge. Since the card was already showing its back side, flipping it upwards simply brings that same back side (which is now upside down) into view.

The back of the card is plain white, so the result is a plain white square. Looking at the choices, Options A, B, C, and E show various diagrams. Option D shows a blank white square, which matches our result.

The correct choice is **D**.
